segments.text: his bomber is on fire, his parachute is burning, and he jumps anyway.
A night fighter has ripped the bomber open, five and a half kilometres up. Burn, or jump. He picks the quick way down.
He wakes up in deep snow, under a hole smashed through the pine trees. Nothing is broken. Just a twisted knee.
But now he's a prisoner, and the Gestapo don't believe a word. No parachute? Then he's a spy, and he buried it.
So he tells them: go and look. They search the wood, and the wreck. The harness straps: still folded. His parachute never left the plane.
So the Germans put it in writing. He fell {18,000|eighteen thousand} feet with no parachute. True in all respects.
Four of his crew never came home. I was wrong. Case closed. It all began the night
